In detail

An outer-Pest district that reintroduced funded foot patrols in summer 2023 after residents reported rising break-ins and car thefts, which local coverage linked partly to the period's inflation and economic pressure; the patrols (46 days, 2pm-10pm around the Kossuth promenade and parks) logged 424 person-checks and 41 violation reports, mostly for public drinking, with residents giving mixed feedback and continuing to flag homelessness and street issues around the Pacsirta housing estate. Sources checked: Mach.hu, 27 Sep 2023 (reintroduced foot patrols, resident feedback).
